name: top-metadata-function-keeps-identity
expression: (let [f (with-meta (fn [n] n) {:marker 1})] [(fn? f) (identical? f (eval f)) ((eval f) 42) (meta (eval f))])

name: nested-metadata-function-after-top-do-prefix
expression: (do (def review-meta-effects (atom [])) (let [f (with-meta (fn [n] n) {:marker 1})] (try (eval (list 'do '(swap! review-meta-effects conj :prefix) (list 'identity f))) (catch Throwable e nil))) @review-meta-effects)
